plugin_path.description: Absolute path to the archive.so plugin file

archive_format.description: Default archive format; must be one supported by libarchive

compression_suffix.description: Compression suffix appended to archive filename (e.g., 'gz' → archive.tar.gz)

archive_subfolder_date.description: Whether to auto-create date-subfolders (YYYY/MM) inside archive_directory

archive_directory.description: Base directory for storing archived messages

extra_mime_types.description: List of additional MIME types (beyond standard text messages) to archive
